title: mattstack bindings manifest (pack/skills.jsonc fragment or generated packs/<pack>/skills.jsonc)
description: Consumer-repo manifest: enabled stack skills, the pipeline stage roster, and slot bindings for parameterized skills. JSONC: JSON plus full-line // comments; no trailing commas.

version.description: Manifest format version. This schema describes version 1.

extends.description: Fragment only: the base pack whose fragment layers under this one, as <plugin>@<marketplace>. One level; a base pack cannot extend. Never present in a generated file.

base.description: Fragment only: true marks a base pack, one that other packs name with extends. A base pack never claims a repo, gets no bindings file of its own, and does not count as a second pack in its zone. Never present in a generated file.

enabled.description: Stack skills this repo uses. Declarative record in phase 1; not read by resolve-args.sh.

pipelines.description: Stage roster for compile (work type -> stage skills). The work orchestrator's order is fixed; a pack lists all eight stage-* engines.

additionalProperties.description: Slot name -> inner skill name, for one wrapper skill.

bindings.description: Wrapper skill name -> slot bindings. The only section resolve-args.sh reads.
